description: Implement the professional audio analysis engine with real-time FFT processing, frequency band separation, beat detection, BPM estimation, energy tracking, and globally accessible audio state.
steps: Create src/audio-engine/types.ts defining AudioState interface with all required properties: bass, subBass, kick, snare, mids, highs, vocals, energy, dropDetected, spectrum (Float32Array of 256 bands), bpm, beatDetected, peakDetected, silence, transitionDetected, waveform, rms, spectralCentroid, spectralFlatness

Create src/audio-engine/AudioAnalyzer.ts - the main audio analysis class using Web Audio API AnalyserNode with FFT size 2048. Methods: initialize(stream: MediaStream), analyze(): AudioState, getFrequencyBand(low, high), destroy()

Create src/audio-engine/FrequencyBands.ts - utility to split FFT data into named frequency bands: subBass (20-60Hz), bass (60-250Hz), lowMids (250-500Hz), mids (500-2kHz), upperMids (2k-4kHz), highs (4k-8kHz), brilliance (8k-20kHz). Use proper frequency-to-bin mapping based on sample rate

Create src/audio-engine/BeatDetector.ts - onset detection using energy flux algorithm. Track energy history, detect sudden increases above adaptive threshold. Output beat timing, strength, and confidence. Include tempo estimation using autocorrelation on beat history

Create src/audio-engine/EnergyTracker.ts - track overall energy, detect drops (sudden energy decrease after high energy period), detect buildups (gradually increasing energy), detect silence (energy below threshold for N frames), detect peaks (local maxima in energy)
Create src/audio-engine/BPMEstimator.ts - estimate BPM using autocorrelation of onset function. Maintain a rolling BPM estimate with confidence. Support tempo range 60-200 BPM
Create src/audio-engine/AudioSmoother.ts - utility for temporal smoothing of audio values using exponential moving average with configurable attack/release times to prevent jitter

Create src/audio-engine/AudioManager.ts - singleton manager that handles audio context creation, device enumeration, stream acquisition (microphone or system audio via Electron desktopCapturer), and exposes the current AudioState globally
Create src/audio-engine/index.ts exporting all public APIs
Create src/audio-engine/__tests__/FrequencyBands.test.ts - unit test frequency band splitting with synthetic FFT data
Create src/audio-engine/__tests__/BeatDetector.test.ts - unit test beat detection with simulated energy patterns
acceptance_criteria: AudioAnalyzer can be instantiated and provides typed AudioState output
FrequencyBands correctly maps frequency ranges to FFT bin indices
BeatDetector detects beats from synthetic energy data in tests
BPMEstimator provides tempo estimation from beat intervals
EnergyTracker detects drops, buildups, silence, and peaks
